if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('existingCorporateId')) { console.log('Missing existingCorporateId. Expected existing Corporate ID 3220.'); pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); }
console.log('Creating Brand: ' + brandCode + ' under existing CorporateId: ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('existingCorporateId'));
try { jsonData = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { console.log('Create Brand response is not valid JSON: ' + pm.response.text()); }

console.log('Creating Hotel Group: ' + hgCode + ' under existing CorporateId: ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('existingCorporateId') + ' BrandId: ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('brandId'));
try { jsonData = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { console.log('Create Hotel Group response is not valid JSON: ' + pm.response.text()); }

if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('existingCorporateId') || !pm.collectionVariables.get('brandId') || !pm.collectionVariables.get('hotelGroupId')) { console.log('Missing existingCorporateId, brandId, or hotelGroupId. Hotel must be created only after previous requests succeed.'); pm.execution.setNextRequest(null); }

console.log('Creating Hotel: ' + hotelCode + ' under existing CorporateId: ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('existingCorporateId') + ' BrandId: ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('brandId') + ' HotelGroupId: ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('hotelGroupId') + ' | timezone abbreviation: ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('mappedHotelTimezone'));
try { jsonData = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { console.log('Create Hotel response is not valid JSON: ' + pm.response.text()); }
